facts.fact: The PAENS project's 2024 work plan for health states that the Dossier Patient Partagé is in pilot deployment and testing in 2024, to be supported with IT equipment, digital patient cards, bandwidth and user training, without naming the sites or their number; the page is undated, so the plan year, 2024, is used.

The PAENS project plans US$1,000,000 in 2024, of US$4,500,000 in its procurement plan for IT equipment (computers, tablets, phones), to support the pilot deployment of the Dossier Patient Partagé together with two other platforms; the page names the World Bank as paying the project's strategic assistance from Gates Foundation funds and states no domestic budget line.

The work plan presents the Dossier Patient Partagé as an existing platform of the health ministry (MSAS), whose digital health unit CSSDOS is to be reinforced with recruited experts and developers, and whose steering and technical committees for digital health the minister set up by order; plan year 2024.
